scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/ui.js && node --check src/transport.js && node --check src/proxy-health.js && node --check src/schema.js && node --check src/core.js && node --test

DB.description: D1 database for users, settings, quota counters, and proxy health. Provision through Cloudflare's supported deployment flow.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Strong unique admin password. Set as a Worker secret during deployment; do not reuse your Cloudflare login password.

ENABLE_CRON.description: Optional. Set to 1 only after review to enable scheduled proxy health scans; default is off.
